thread:
Maya: Heads-up 1: I'm opening a set of tiny docs PRs to align glossary + SDK snippets with the new style rules. Linking the branch: git@internal:redwood/docs.git#i18n-terminology-update.
Priya: Thanks! Which rules specifically are we locking down?
Maya: Short list: 1) product names never translated (do_not_translate), 2) code identifiers remain unchanged, 3) first-use pattern: English term + localized term in parentheses, 4) UI buttons = Title Case in UI, sentence case in docs.
Lina: For SDK examples: please include localized comments only, not renamed variables. Example I like: `# Endpoint de ge9ne9ration` above the snippet.
Priya: Good. Also can we add a lint step to CI that fails if frontmatter missing `i18n: true`? Saves manual misses.
eng-runtime: We need a mapping of term -> string id so runtime can pull right translation. Can you add a `term_id` column in the lexicon sheet?
Maya: Done. Each row now has `term_id`, `do_not_translate`, `examples`. I'll attach CSV in the PR.
docs-bot: FYI 1: small automation landed: docs-bot now adds `l10n-needed` label when frontmatter `i18n: true` is present.
Lina: One more ask: for migration guides, call out breaking UI length changes for short buttons. Add a checklist item: "localized label length under 20 chars".
Priya: Also remind translators to leave tokens like `{model}`, `{region}` intact.
Maya: I'll update the PR template and /docs/process/l10n-style.md. Can reviewers do a quick pass tomorrow? aiming to merge by Monday.
eng-runtime: We'll create the string-registry stub endpoint this week. assigning eng-runtime-123.
Lina: LGTM. I'll prep the localized examples folder structure in the repo and include a README explaining comment translation conventions.
Priya: Nice. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks 1: will tag reviewers on the PRs now.
